name: Human-AGVQA
description: Benchmark for assessing AI-generated videos of human activities, focusing on visual quality and semantic distortions across diverse text-to-video outputs. It includes 6,000 videos from 15 T2V models and human subjective ratings.
evaluation_method: Human subjective ratings aggregated into quality and distortion scores; typically correlation with human judgments and/or pairwise agreement.
notes: Dataset of AI-generated human activity videos drawn from popular text-to-video models. Useful for studying both perceptual quality and semantic consistency in generated video.
